mode.description: Control how the number should be displayed in the UI. Can be set to box or slider to force a display mode.
The mode off the text entity. Must be either text or password.

command_topic.description:
The MQTT topic to publish commands to change the text state.
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/number.mqtt/#command_topic

pattern.description: A valid regular expression the text being set or received must match with.

max.description: The maximum size of a text being set or received (maximum is 255).

min.description: The minimum size of a text being set or received.

name.description:
The name of the MQTT text.
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/number.mqtt#name

qos.description:
The maximum QoS level to be used when receiving and publishing messages.
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/number.mqtt/#qos

retain.description:
If the published message should have the retain flag on or not.
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/number.mqtt/#retain

state_topic.description:
The MQTT topic subscribed to receive state updates.
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/number.mqtt/#state_topic

value_template.description: Defines a template to extract the text state value from the payload received on state_topic.

availability.description: A list of MQTT topics subscribed to receive availability (online/offline) updates.

availability_mode.description: When availability is configured, this controls the conditions needed to set the entity to available. Valid entries are all, any, and latest.

availability_template.description: Defines a template to extract device’s availability from the availability_topic. To determine the devices’s availability result of this template will be compared to payload_available and payload_not_available.

availability_topic.description: The MQTT topic subscribed to receive availability (online/offline) updates.

payload_available.description: The payload that represents the available state.

payload_not_available.description: The payload that represents the unavailable state.

device.description: Information about the device this sensor is a part of to tie it into the device registry. Only works through MQTT discovery and when unique_id is set.

configuration_url.description: A link to the webpage that can manage the configuration of this device. Can be either an http://, https:// or an internal homeassistant:// URL

connections.description: A list of connections of the device to the outside world as a list of tuples.

hw_version.description: The hardware version of the device.

identifiers.description: A list of IDs that uniquely identify the device. For example a serial number.

model_id.description: The model identifier of the device.

serial_number.description: The serial number of the device.

suggested_area.description: Suggest an area if the device isn’t in one yet.

sw_version.description: The firmware version of the device.

via_device.description: Identifier of a device that routes messages between this device and Home Assistant. Examples of such devices are hubs, or parent devices of a sub-device.

enabled_by_default.description: Flag which defines if the entity should be enabled when first added.

entity_category.description: The category of the entity. When set, the entity category must be "diagnostic" for sensors.

icon.description: Icon to use for the entity created.

json_attributes_template.description: Defines a template to extract the JSON dictionary from messages received on the json_attributes_topic.

json_attributes_topic.description: The MQTT topic subscribed to receive a JSON dictionary payload and then set as sensor attributes.

object_id.description: An ID that uniquely identifies this sensor. If two sensors have the same unique ID, Home Assistant will raise an exception.

unique_id.description: An ID that uniquely identifies this sensor. If two sensors have the same unique ID, Home Assistant will raise an exception.
